purpose: Identical, fictional no-customer-data benchmark prompts for all builder candidates

briefs.problem: Visitors cannot tell which repair services are offered or request a quote quickly
briefs.design_goal: Mobile-first service list, clear trust cues and prominent quote call to action
briefs.functional_gate: Synthetic quote inquiry must reach an authorized local test endpoint; client delivery is not assumed

briefs.problem: Customers need menu, hours, location and contact details on mobile
briefs.design_goal: Accessible menu navigation, readable food descriptions and easy contact pathway
briefs.functional_gate: Synthetic contact inquiry must be verified at a test destination; reservations are not promised

briefs.problem: Travelers need to request a repair with service type and vehicle notes
briefs.design_goal: Mobile-friendly urgent-service path and clear non-emergency scope
briefs.functional_gate: Synthetic repair request must be delivered to the agreed test destination; no live dispatch integration inferred
